project: Test Design Skill - Commercial Voice Agent

direction.name: Bioluminescent Pulse & Deep Surface
direction.story: A celestial voice presence balanced with tactile enterprise glass surfaces. Brings commercial voice AI to life through ambient responsiveness and disciplined metrics.

colors.usage: ambient light halo, audio reactive pulses

motion.name: orb-breathing
motion.meaning: Voice agent is actively connected, idling in ready state

motion.name: speech-ripple
motion.meaning: Active voice transmission and real-time synthesis
motion.trigger: agent speaking or user voice detected
motion.properties: nested rings expanding outward, scale 1.0 → 1.4, opacity 0.8 → 0

interactions.name: Mic Toggle Interaction
interactions.trigger: click on microphone pill or press Space
interactions.feedback: Orb ignites into vibrant blue aura, status changes from Ready to Listening

interactions.name: Audio Mode Switch
interactions.feedback: Smooth crossfade of conversation prompts and active model profile

components.name: LuminescentVoiceOrb
components.description: Interactive multi-ring glowing 3D-effect sphere responding to idle, listening, and speaking states

components.name: MetricCard
components.description: Clean dark enterprise card displaying live latency, active sessions, and speech recognition confidence

components.name: LiveTranscriptStream
components.description: Streaming conversation bubble list with agent vs user differentiation and timestamps

components.name: AudioControlBar
components.description: Floating pill bar with mic toggle, audio input select, volume VU meter, and end-call action

screens.name: Main Test Design Console
screens.description: Single-view command center featuring the glowing voice orb as hero center, flanked by enterprise telemetry metrics and a real-time transcript audit feed.

dos: Keep backgrounds deep ink/sapphire (#00041B) to let the glowing sphere pop with clarity.
Use 1px border highlights (#182C4A) with subtle backdrop blurs.
Ensure all telemetry metrics use mono font for tabular alignment.
donts: Do not use multi-colored rainbow neon glows; restrict accents to azure (#376CF6) and lavender-indigo (#8284F9).
Do not clutter the focal area around the sphere.
Do not omit reduced-motion fallbacks for glowing animations.
